import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int B = 1000000;
    static final long M = 998244353L;
    static final long mod = 1000000007L;
    static long n, countA, countB;
    static int[] sumArray = new int[10];
    static int answerVal;
    static List<Integer>[] valVec = new ArrayList[10];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            valVec[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void generateValues(int depth, long val) {
        if (depth > 6) return;
        long w = (++countA) - val + M;
        valVec[depth].add((int)w);
        sumArray[depth] = (int)((sumArray[depth] + w) % mod);
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            generateValues(depth + 1, val * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static void evaluate(long v) {
        if (v > n) return;
        if (v < n / B && 10 * v > n / B) {
            for (int i = 0, p = 1; i <= 6; i++, p *= 10) {
                long w = (countB + (long)(M - p) * v + M) % M;
                List<Integer> list = valVec[i];
                int c = lowerBound(list, (int)(M - w));
                int cCount = list.size() - c;
                answerVal = (int)((answerVal + (long)list.size() * w + sumArray[i] + (mod - M) * cCount) % mod);
            }
            countB += countA;
            return;
        }
        ++countB;
        answerVal = (int)((answerVal + (countB - v % M + M) % M) % mod);
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            evaluate(v * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        generateValues(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(valVec[i]);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            evaluate(i);
        }
        System.out.println(answerVal);
    }
}
